name: acceptance-gate
description: Acceptance gate for AI-generated features. Normalizes requirements into acceptance contracts, self-generates eval cases across 4 executor types, verifies with fresh-context subagents, and enforces evidence-backed verdicts via deterministic hooks. Includes a design-quality gate (a11y/contrast, AI-slop) for web-UI surfaces. v1.16 adds the morphological-scan coverage skill (Zwicky-box AC-space enumeration with per-axis CE evidence) and a contract Coverage section surfaced on the Gate-1 card. v1.17 adds the Layout Contract discipline + layout meter (measure_layout.js) to ux-ui-craft, pairing with design-loop's layout-token-only blocking rule. v1.18 adds the S1 gap-probe: a clean-context critic probes the Gate-1 artifact set one-pass (design/contract/evals/ledger), dispositions are P0-not-silent, and the Gate-1 card renders the 'Phản biện context sạch' block with fail-visible flags, plus the gate decision commands /approve (Gate 1) and /signoff (Gate 2) and the /acceptance-report metrics aggregator (minutes vs baseline, verdict mix, gate hygiene). Cuts human acceptance time from hours to minutes. v1.19 adds the cross-layer false-green rail (wave 1): a (cross-layer) contract tag + backend-effect pairing rule + lint W4 + an advisory network-truth vocab (network_observed) in ui-check evidence with app-origin scoping, plus degradation stances for network-blind drivers (curl/mobile). v1.20 makes mobile a first-class surface (native-E2E test lane, UI-layer evidence only, W5 backend-target presence check) and gives pairing rule (c) CI teeth — pre-merge BLOCKS a (cross-layer) criterion with no layer: backend-effect eval — plus a network_observed distribution readout in /acceptance-report. v1.20.1 closes a section-scan bug class shared by four parsers (pre-merge teeth, coverage lint, gate-card, evidence-page): a `###` sub-heading inside `## Criteria` no longer truncates the scan, so criteria after it are still gated, linted and rendered on the Gate-1 card. v1.22 adds the rules ledger to pre-merge-check.sh: clean must be PROVEN — every rule block records ran/declared-off through one ledger_mark chokepoint against a fixed EXPECTED list, a machine-readable summary line (pre-merge-check: rules ran= declared-off= expected=) whose expected count is derived from EXPECTED rather than from the running totals, and any ledger mismatch is an internal-gate error (exit 2). This catches silently-skipped rule blocks that no input-validation blacklist could enumerate. v1.22.1 hardening wave: declared-but-unusable scope/filter values now exit 2 as a class (empty --base/--slug, typo'd or /-containing slug filters, PRE_MERGE_BASE set-but-empty with +x set-detection, declared base on a git-less root), an explicit --base still overrides an empty env var, VIOLATION [scope] prints on stdout like every other VIOLATION. (Repo-internal maintenance tooling also hardened — sync-plugin-packages.sh rejects extra argv — but that script ships only in the kit repo, not in this package.) v1.23 renders the Gate-2 "Ngoài hợp đồng" block on the decision card: real defects that fall outside the approved scope are shown as human work with three explicit choices (known limits / new contract / widen scope), plus the coverage-cluster flag; a review-findings.md without those sections renders exactly as before. v1.24 stops an unjudged PASS at the merge boundary: a directory that CLAIMS release (evidence declaring verdict PASS, or a contract at status implemented+) can no longer be invisible to the gate — missing contract.md, risk_tier or status is now a VIOLATION instead of a silent skip, while an abandoned scaffold stays silent by design; and a human_signoff that is a placeholder rather than a name (PENDING/TBD/TODO/n/a/none/unsigned/waiting, a bare > | -, or an unfilled <...> template) is rejected, with a NOTE stating plainly that this prefix list is short and fixed so rewording is not a fix. signoff.approvers stays informational and is deliberately NOT parsed. v1.25 adds single-sourced per-section markdown boundary (lib/md-section.js) shared by gate-card and evidence-page. v1.26 adds the design-pass in-harness design ritual: a dedicated aesthetics+UX session on the running clickable build in the Browser pane (S1-D), with a 3-rung material ladder (real-components/scaffold/static, declared in the session note), a named DS-rule ladder (repo skill → repo tokens → shadcn default), hard token-only constraints (no new hex, no webfonts, no components/ui edits), and a state×breakpoint×theme capture note written back to the feature workspace for Gate 1. v1.27 ships references/opportunity-template.md — the discovery Cổng-0 opportunity mold with machine-readable frontmatter (OPP-FRONTMATTER-TEMPLATE marker, round-trip-tested against the kit's real frontmatter reader) and the "Nguồn ngoài & phạm vi kế thừa" inheritance-classification field (philosophy/logic inheritable; design-language/form defaults to NO — the consuming repo's standard wins, and unclassified external material blocks the Cổng-0 signature). v1.28 ships references/human-facing-language.md — the human-facing language law (N1-N6 + two quick tests + before/after examples) as an enforced reference the card, report and status renderers must load before writing a single human-facing sentence, plus two marked presentation templates: PLAN-SUMMARY-TABLE-TEMPLATE (three columns: what the user sees / what it touches / which criteria it serves) and DECISION-DIAGRAM-TEMPLATE (mermaid, triggered when a decision point has three or more sequential steps or two or more branches). The law table is byte-identical across its two homes (the enforced reference and the workflow spec) and the reviewer may reject a card at the gate, logging it to the decisions ledger as a kit defect. v1.29: hình tại điểm quyết định chọn theo mặt phẳng qua bảng tra DECISION-DIAGRAM-SURFACES, kèm phép thử nhìn-thấy-hình. v1.30: /start session-entry ritual (human-typed, both harnesses locked). v1.31: bản đồ sản phẩm máy sinh (PRODUCT-MAP.md) + nghi thức phiên nghiệm thu (Cổng Giá trị). v1.32: thẻ nói tiếng người trọn câu — bullet Coverage/Out-of-scope hard-wrap được nối trọn dòng, khối Coverage + gap-probe nối vào tầng card-plain (key coverage_plain/gap_probe_plain, khuôn CARD-PLAIN-KEYS hai chiều), mọi fallback in text thô của contract/ledger/probe đều lột dấu markdown; sev finding vẫn do script render và overlay không giấu được hàng nào. v1.32.1 hotfix: the re-pin sha-match rule becomes an aggregate relation (every cited lane must exist with all-zero suites_exit; at least ONE cited lane must match verified_commit) — the per-section form falsely flagged every historical Re-pin section the moment a SECOND re-pin event landed. v1.33 adds judge-required-evidence: a non-PASS judge verdict must carry required_evidence[] (each item one concrete piece of evidence + where to get it; a lazy judge is exposed by the pinned marker instead of silently tolerated), the Gate-2 card renders the missing-evidence list per judgment item, the judge persona gains the actionable/no-evidence-shopping rules, and scripts/acceptance-gold.mjs derives the gold set (human decisions over machine proposals from existing Gate-2 signatures) plus the judge-agreement (G3) report consumed by /acceptance-report — purely derived, no new files. v1.38 unifies the workspace-record law: evidence-report verdict joins NAV_RULES (usesEvidence/missingArtifact), one MAP_LABELS table for product-map --check and /start (mapState), configList reads key-line comments, --root fails loud, and the UAT-COPY-PROCEDURE block makes the uat-session template copy procedure machine-extractable. v1.39 ships the measure-birth reference mold (references/measure-birth.md: positive-control / break-the-real-object / pinned-message sections, two living samples from the kit's own suite, and the defect-class table sourced from docs/research/known-limits-ledger.tsv — the known-limits lifecycle ledger introduced alongside), backing the MEASURE-BIRTH-CLAUSE in feature-loop ≥ 1.27.
